subject: POC kickoff & environment setup - scheduling and prep
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@acmeanalytics.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff & environment setup - proposed times

Hi Sam / Priya —

Great to connect last week. We're excited to get the hands-on POC kicked off for Acme Analytics. To make the session productive, we'd like to cover: prompt review, routing/load test plan, and verifying environment access (API keys, VPC allowlist, sandbox/staging endpoints).

Proposed 90-minute blocks (PT):
- Thu 2025-10-02 10:00–11:30
- Fri 2025-10-03 10:00–11:30
- Fri 2025-10-03 14:00–15:30

Please confirm preferred slot and whether you want Redwood to run a short load test at the end (we can simulate up to 50 RPS with representative payloads). I attached a short POC checklist and a stub for sandbox credential exchange.

Attachments: Redwood-POC-Checklist.pdf (POC agenda + pre-reqs), sandbox-credentials-stub.txt

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

From: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2025-10-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & environment setup - proposed times

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — Fri 10/03 looks best. Morning would be ideal but we can probably do the 2pm slot if nothing else works across our team. Please loop in engineering and security so they can confirm allowlist/IPs and sandbox access.

Also: can you include a short list of the staging endpoints and the exact IPs we should allow? Our security team needs that to open the ticket.

Sam
Sam Thompson | Head of ML Engineering
Acme Analytics
sam.thompson@acmeanalytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@acmeanalytics.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-01T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & environment setup - proposed times

Thanks, Sam —

If morning is preferred, can you confirm earliest available window on 10/03? We can do 10:00–11:30 PT. If your team prefers 2pm, that also works — we just want to confirm engineer availability.

For security — short answers below so you can open the ticket: 
- Redwood staging endpoints: https://staging.redwood-inference.com and https://sandbox-inference.redwood-inference.com (TLS required)
- IP ranges to allow (egress to Redwood): 34.201.16.0/20, 52.23.44.0/22, 13.56.0.0/15 (these are the NAT egress pools for the sandbox region we'll use)
- API keys: we'll generate a short-lived sandbox key for the POC; please provide the sandbox account email to receive it securely.

We also typically ask for one staging prompt and a sample payload so we can pre-warm KV caches for the demo. If you'd like load testing, let us know target RPS and average token size.

If it's helpful, I'll loop in our SRE, Dev, and Solutions Engineer to validate specifics — tagging Steph and Dev on the next message.

Best,
Marissa

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2025-10-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & environment setup - proposed times

Morning Marissa —

We can do 10/03 but prefer a morning slot (10:00 PT). A few notes:
- Procurement needs a one-page quote/statement of work for the POC (duration: 2 weeks, support hours) to issue a PO — I can get that after we agree times.
- For security, please confirm all TLS endpoints and whether any inbound firewall rules are required on our side (we prefer to only allow egress to your NAT IPs).
- We'll provide sandbox account details and an internal contact for API key exchange — aiming to send by end of day Oct 2.

Thanks,
Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@acmeanalytics.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmeanalytics.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Action: Acme POC environment prep + allowlist

Hi Dev / Steph —

Looping you in to help validate allowlist and prepare the sandbox key before the kickoff. Summary for the ticket:
- Customer: Acme Analytics (sandbox account will be provided by their security team)
- Required outbound egress (customer -> Redwood): 34.201.16.0/20, 52.23.44.0/22, 13.56.0.0/15
- Staging endpoints (TLS): https://staging.redwood-inference.com, https://sandbox-inference.redwood-inference.com
- We will create a short-lived API key with "sandbox.poc" scope and expiration 2025-10-17. Delivery method: secure text file upload to their SFTP or emailed to the sandbox account contact — Priya indicated she'd send account details today.
- POC agenda: 90-min session covering prompt review, routing rules, and a 15-min load test targetting 20–30 RPS with 150–350 token averages.

Attachments: Redwood-POC-Checklist.pdf, sandbox-credentials-stub.txt

Dev — can you confirm you can run the load test and have a small harness ready? Steph — can you validate the key scope and expiration?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@acmeanalytics.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2025-10-02T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action: Acme POC environment prep + allowlist

Thanks Marissa —

I can run the load harness during the session. A few technical confirmations:
- Load test: I'll prepare a small k6 script to simulate 20–30 RPS, 200 token average payloads. If you want to ramp to 50 RPS we should discuss rate limits for the sandbox key.
- IP allowlist: confirmed these egress ranges look fine; will verify with infra for the exact NAT IPs and confirm on Monday morning (10/03).
- API key: I'll generate the sandbox.poc key with the requested expiration and upload to their SFTP once they provide credentials.

Please let me know the sample prompt you want pre-warmed and any specific routing rules (e.g., fallback to smaller model for long sequences).

- Dev

From: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmeanalytics.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-03T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action: Acme POC environment prep + allowlist

Morning all —

10:00–11:30 PT on Fri 2025-10-03 works for the Acme team — we'll provide sandbox account details and an SFTP endpoint to receive the key by EOD today. Procurement will wait for Marissa's one-pager and then issue the PO.

Sample prompt to pre-warm (short): 
"Given a user's transaction history and profile, generate a 3-sentence summary highlighting anomalies and suggested follow-ups."

We'd like the load test at 20 RPS with ~200 tokens avg. Thanks for looping infra/SRE — we appreciate the clarity on IP ranges.

See you Friday — Sam
